units.title: Nature, Concept and History of Patents
units.topics: Nature and Concept and Types of Intellectual Property, Historical background of the Patent System in India and in the global context, Concept of Patentability and non-patentability.

units.title: Patent Filing, Opposition and Revocation
units.topics: Patent filing Procedure in India and concept of patent of addition, divisional patent application, Opposition, Surrender, Revocation of Patents.

units.title: Rights, Licensing and Infringement
units.topics: Technology Transfer and Patent Licensing, Patentee Rights - Product and Process patents, Infringement and remedies under Indian Patent Act 1970.

units.title: Authorities and International Conventions
units.topics: Authorities under Patent Act, Compulsory Licensing, International Instruments: Paris Convention, Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT), Budapest Treaty, TRIPS Agreement.

units.title: Concept and Principles of Copyright
units.topics: Concept and Principles of Copyright and Neighbouring Rights, Historical background and Development of Copyright Law at National and International context, Copyrightable subject matter.

units.title: Neighbouring Rights and Registration
units.topics: Neighbouring Rights- Broadcasting Organization Rights and Performers right, Filing Procedure of Copyright, Term of protection, Ownership of Copyright.

units.title: Rights, Assignment and Licensing
units.topics: Rights conferred under Copyright Act: Economic Rights, Moral Rights, Assignment and Licensing of Copyright, Compulsory and Statutory Licensing, Copyright Societies.

units.title: Infringement, Authorities and International Conventions
units.topics: Infringement of Copyright and remedies, Exceptions to Infringement (Fair use doctrine), Authorities under Copyright Act 1957, International Conventions: Berne Convention, Universal Copyright Convention, WCT, WPPT.

units.title: Concept and Types of Trademarks
units.topics: Concept of Trademarks, Historical background and Development in India and globally, Different Kinds of Marks: Service, Certification, Collective, Associated marks, Well-known trademark and passing off, International classifications (Nice).

units.title: Registration and Ownership Rights
units.topics: Procedure of registration of Trademark, Grounds for Refusal (Absolute & Relative), Term of Protection, Rights of Trademark owner.

units.title: Assignment, Licensing and Infringement
units.topics: Assignment and Transmission, Licensing of Trademark, Infringement and remedies (Civil, Criminal, Administrative), Difference between Passing off and Infringement, Domain names and cyber squatting.

units.title: Authorities and International Conventions
units.topics: Authorities under Trade Marks Act 1999, International Treaties: Paris Convention, Madrid Agreement and Protocol, Trademark Law Treaty.

units.title: Part I: Industrial Designs
units.topics: Meaning of Design, essential requirements, exclusions, procedure for registration, copyright in registered designs, assignment, licensing, infringement, remedies, Design Act 2000, Locarno Agreement.

units.title: Part II: Geographical Indications
units.topics: Meaning and concept of Geographical Indications, registration procedure, rights conferred, infringement and remedies, Geographical Indications of Goods Act 1999, Lisbon Agreement.

units.title: Part III: Semiconductor Integrated Circuits Layout-Design
units.topics: Conditions for registration, procedure, effect, duration, infringement, authorities under The Semiconductor Integrated Circuits Layout-Design Act 2000.

units.title: Part IV: Plant Variety Protection Act
units.topics: Meaning, benefit sharing and farmers rights, registration procedure, effect, term, authorities under Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers Rights Act 2001, offences, penalties, infringement.

units.title: Patent Search Analysis
units.topics: Conducting patent search on databases (InPASS, Google Patents, Espacenet, WIPO Patentscope), patent analysis and landscaping report.

units.title: Trademark Search and Application Drafting
units.topics: Trademark clearance search using IP India public search, drafting Trademark Application (TM-A).

units.title: Copyright Registration Drafting
units.topics: Drafting copyright registration application for literary, artistic, or software works.

units.title: Viva-Voce Examination
units.topics: Viva-voce examination on journal submissions, case studies, and practical IP filing documents.

notes: One-year annual diploma program; credits not specified in syllabus text.
